title: Owner-signed Staging Backup policy reader grant lifecycle composition contract

phases.objective: Define a fail-closed, independently approved Staging Local Connector composition boundary for one-shot reader grants, governed read-only census, replay defense and verified revocation, without exposing generic privileged SQL execution or attempting live grants.

e2e_journeys.actor: Independent audited Staging database administration connector
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A signed, exact-head one-shot grant can be simulated through trusted adapters and produces census evidence only after narrow SELECT grants are validated and the temporary account is provably revoked; otherwise returns blocked.
steps: Bind requested grant to independently measured Staging device, exact release SHA, runtime-db, exact schema and private Docker subnet.
Validate exact plan digest, owner Ed25519 signature, operation type and maximum ten-minute lease.
Persist the unique run ID in an atomic replay ledger before any simulated account creation.
Read physical table inventory and reject preexisting principals, then provision synthetic four-table reader through injected trusted adapter.
Verify fixed table-scoped SELECT-only grants and simulate independent reader census, and always revoke and recheck identity absence.
Fail closed when signing, grant, census, audit or cleanup cannot be independently verified, with no real resource mutations.
assertions: No raw SQL admin executor, generic remote API, root credentials or Production destination is introduced.
Owner approval by chat text or GitHub comment alone is not an Ed25519 grant-execution token.
The caller cannot dynamically select a user, schema, privilege, table, host pattern, target environment or network.
No positive certificate is possible with failed revocation, failed audit or unavailable census.
All tests are synthetic; separately permitted real Staging DB admin channel and live grant/restore certification are still required.
